profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing
profile.summary: Feel free to connect with me and ask me any questions, thanks!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Diagnose and resolve input defects on simulated aircraft displays, so pilot interactions register reliably during customer training.

Refactor the aircraft display data pipeline so each display runs at its own configurable refresh rate, decoupling systems that previously shared a single update cycle.

Deliver quality-of-life improvements to the teams internal process manager, including showing which machine each process runs on and opening an executables file location in one click, making it faster to locate and manage hundreds of simulation processes across dozens of machines.

Track down and fix defects in the core simulation logic across C++, C#, and Fortran subsystems, documenting root causes so the team can diagnose similar issues faster.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and built a C++ radio communications microservice, shipped to a customer, that relays traffic among dozens of simulated radios across a distributed simulator over UDP.

Implemented a UDP interface between the radio client and the simulation, defining the message protocol that keeps radio state and transmissions synchronized in real time during live training.

Designed a runtime process manager in Java, delivered to a customer through Agile sprint cycles, that launches and terminates simulation executables on demand, automating process control during live runs.

Added logging utilities to the after-action review tools, giving developers clearer visibility into system behavior and speeding up debugging of training sessions.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed and prototyped the companys financial forecasting and budgeting user interface in Retool and JavaScript across frontend and backend, partnering with engineers and product leads to deliver it to the companys first clients.

Enabled budgets to scale in both breadth and depth by designing data structures for hierarchical financial data. This work was featured in product demos to prospective business partners.

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
Shipped three production Next.js websites for Arisings clients and partners, owning each from build through launch and ongoing maintenance against client requirements and deadlines.

Raised the performance and search visibility of client sites by establishing consistent frontend optimization practices across projects, so every launch met the same quality bar.

projects.title: Unity Movement Framework
projects.description:
Build a reusable foundation for character movement in video games, so new moves like dashing or wall running can be added as plug-ins without rewriting existing code.

Design a simple framework for other developers to pick up and extend, with clear organization and documentation, and controls that feel smooth and responsive on any hardware.

projects.title: Moneylang
projects.description:
Constructed a small-scale compiler in WSL using Python for Moneylang, a two-character programming language

Rapidly designed and implemented a series of compiler layers, including lexer, parser, code generation, and virtual machine
